purpose: Configuration management for SMRT modules with support for multiple formats (JS, TS, JSON, YAML), environment variables, and type-safe configuration.

patterns.name: Package configuration
patterns.description: Get configuration for a specific SMRT package with defaults.

patterns.name: Config file
patterns.description: Create smrt.config.js in project root for framework-wide configuration.

pitfalls: Config files are auto-detected from project root - ensure smrt.config.js is in the right location
Environment variables override config file values
